utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Gus, I've heard a bit about the repair drive from neighbors. What do you know about it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, I saw it over at the Johnson's last week. They were helping folks with all sorts of fixes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's interesting, Gus! Did you see if they were working on the park fountain too?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I didn't realize it was moved! Thanks for letting me know, Rosa. I'll still bring my toaster on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, see you then! And don't forget, it's from 9 to 3.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rosa! I'll be there bright and early with my toaster.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hey Cleo, just confirming you're still on for the playground repair drive Saturday at 9?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I'm in! Let me just grab my list to make sure we're set—I want to double-check the start time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Great, it's 9 at the park. I'll have the tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm still trying to pin down a time for the repair drive. Would Saturday morning work for you?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Saturday morning at 10 AM works great! Let's meet at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect, I'll note that down. I just need to double-check the tool availability to make sure we're all set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mina, have you heard what time the repair drive is this weekend? I really need to get that sorted for my blender.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's actually on Sunday now, but still at 10 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh great, thanks Mina! Sunday at 10 works perfectly. I'll finally get my blender fixed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Oren! Are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday? We're starting at 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the community center! I was mixing it up with the playground. So I just bring my hammer, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, a hammer would be great! We'll have some tools too, so just bring what you're comfortable with.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm free most mornings, Bo. Let's aim for Saturday around 9 if that works for everyone else.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday at 9 works for me. See you at the park.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Saturday at 9 it is. I'll put it on the calendar.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Should I bring my own tools or will there be some on site?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm not sure about tools, but the flyer might have details. Want me to grab one for you?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please! That would be really helpful, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I double-checked with Pia—she said the traffic shouldn't be a problem since it's a weekend morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good to know. See you Saturday at 9.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I'll be there with the maps ready!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Alright, let's go. I hope we can get some answers about that fountain.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! Let's head to the park and see what we can find out while we round up some volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good. Do you think we'll have any luck finding people to help?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam, don't forget about the repair drive this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks Vik, I've got it on my calendar! I'll be there with my toolbox ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Awesome! See you Saturday at 10, and if you run into anyone else, let them know too!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey Kira, did you say something about a repair drive? I think I heard about that but I'm blanking on the details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, did you check with Pia about the traffic? She mentioned it could be an issue if we pick a busy time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Traffic? Right, I totally forgot about that. Did Pia say something important?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rey, are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday? I'm gathering supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, Quinn asked me to help rally volunteers. I'm hoping we can get that fountain fixed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, every bit helps! I've got a list of what we need—do you know anyone with spare PVC pipes?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Bring any broken items you have—Tess is already bringing her toaster!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, I'll bring my broken rake then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: A rake? Perfect, I'm sure someone can fix that up easily!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hey Rosa, are you coming to the playground repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Uli! Thanks for asking. The repair drive has actually been moved to Sunday at the community center, from 9 to 3. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, I didn't realize it was moved. I'll have to check my schedule for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Quinn! Are you thinking of joining the repair drive this Saturday? We're starting at 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I'm in! I'm heading to the park later to recruit more volunteers. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's great, Quinn! Every extra pair of hands helps. Good luck at the park!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Hana, I'm glad you're here. I'm still trying to nail down the schedule for the repair drive—it's tricky coordinating everyone's availability.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I remember Vik mentioned it's Saturday at 10 at the community center—are you changing the time?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Vik might've jumped the gun—I'm still confirming with the community center about their availability. I want to make sure we have all the tools sorted before setting a firm time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, just let me know when you need an extra pair of hands!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do! I'm going to check the bulletin board later, so I can pick up a flyer for you too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira! That would be awesome.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hold on, Tess, is the repair drive this Saturday at the park or the community center? I keep forgetting.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Oren, it's actually been moved to Sunday at the community center, from 9 to 3. I almost missed that myself!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sunday? Oh dear, I had Saturday in my head. Thanks for clearing that up, Tess. I'll put it in my calendar this time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, see you there at 9 AM on Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: See you then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Looking forward to working together!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Opal, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? We're meeting at the community center at 10 AM to fix up the playground.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I'll be there! I believe it starts at 9, not 10—I've been tracking the schedule. I'm happy to help direct people to the stations.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, I think you might have a different schedule—Hana and Noah have it at 10 AM too. Let's stick with 10 at the community center, okay?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I heard Faye say it's Saturday at 9 AM at the community center. That works for me.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: But did Pia okay the timing? I recall her saying traffic might be a mess then.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, I didn't know about that. Maybe we should check with Pia to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm free most mornings, say around 9 AM. How does that sound for everyone?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: 9 AM sounds good to me, Eli. I'll bring my toolbox and a few spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, 9 AM works for me. Let's hope we can confirm it soon so I can put it in my calendar.
